data.narrative:
Pickle Robot Company is a Series B robotics and manufacturing venture that has raised $97M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparison universe of nine private peers and one public company (277810.KQ). Directly comparable Series B stage companies in robotics include Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity, with valuations ranging from $1.6B to $2.0B.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. The stage-progression approach applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the $97M total raised, implying a valuation of $184M. The peer-median method references the three same-sector, same-stage comparables, which exhibit a median valuation of $1.8B with a range of $1.6B to $2.0B. This significant dispersion reflects heterogeneity in business model maturity and technology risk across the peer set, which also includes Divergent and Exotec.

The triangulated valuation range spans $157M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $967M. The wide band reflects tension between stage-progression logic—anchored to capital deployed—and peer multiples that assume more advanced market traction or differentiated capability. Resolution of this range depends critically on visibility into Pickle's revenue trajectory, gross margins, and market adoption rates relative to the peer cohort. The stage-progression floor of $184M provides a capital-preservation baseline; the peer median and ceiling require demonstration of comparable growth and unit economics.
